chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel;

3.original: [in the land of light, and there is no measure to]
3.content: in the land of light, and there is no measure to

spiritual_reading:
Within the realm where wisdom is pure, there is a trinal ordering of primary forms, and in that ordering no finite standard can contain their quality.

Those who are spoken of as possessing divinity are the primary determinations of divine love that the Divine Itself brought forth from its own essence. They were set in being as finite receptions that bear the image of infinite greatness.

Those who are spoken of as possessing abundance are the derivative determinations that proceeded from the first forms of that abundance which divine love first brought forth; for when the Divine brought forth the first receptions, those receptions in turn brought forth further receptions from themselves, and this derived fullness was acknowledged as abundance.

And those determinations of abundance also brought forth further receptions; these are called ministering powers because they exist to serve and carry into effect what is higher. Such is the threefold ordering that appears in the realm of wisdom, and its quality is beyond the measuring of lower comprehension.

Hear again: there is also a sense in which those called divine are the outward goings-forth of what is from the Divine, brought into being by the Divine’s own act. These proceeded into spiritual conflict, and by the power of truth from love they abased what is hostile and removed its claim.

And those called abundant are the receptions that proceed from the first living expressions of truth; these too advanced into operation, and by their activity they carried to completion the delight of divine greatness in higher and lower degrees, so that what is above might flow into what is beneath and be fulfilled in use.

Further, the name of divinity is ascribed to every determination of good and truth that is arranged in order under the ruling Divine in its governing form.

And the name of ministering power is ascribed to every operative truth arranged in order under the Divine that is loved as light itself.

And the name of abundance is ascribed to every fullness of good and truth arranged in order under the Divine that mediates, represents, and makes present what is highest.

fills.fill: in the land of light, and there is no measure to
fills.notes: Fits the oldest-layer cosmological register: the triad of primordial forms appears within the Light-realm, whose quality is unbounded and therefore not subject to mensuration by lower degrees. The phrase also balances the later refrain in ¶6.

The passage is establishing a threefold naming: gods (first summonings), rich ones (second-order evocations), angels (third-order evocations). Here the contrast requires a plural designation for the second archetype: “these who are named ‘rich ones’”. This also maintains the impersonal, structural tone of the substrate (classes of beings, not titles).

assessment: Both lacunae are tightly constrained by the chapter’s triadic correspondential structure (first determinations, derived fullness, ministering powers) and by the recurring ‘no measure’ formula; restorations are certain.
